info.name: Estimator CAG
info.description: Calls the /estimate endpoint of the estimator service. Start the server first (VS Code debug config 'Estimator: debug /estimate').

body.raw: {"transcription": "Client (Laura): We run a small chain of three bakeries and we are tired of tracking stock in spreadsheets. We want a web app where each store can see its inventory, log waste at the end of the day, and reorder ingredients from the suppliers we already use. Dev lead (Marco): Do you need separate logins per store, or one login for the whole chain? Laura: Separate logins per store, plus one admin account for head office who can see all three locations and the monthly totals. Marco: Should the reorder step send the order by email to suppliers, or do you need an integration with their systems? Laura: Email is fine for now. Later we might want a dashboard that shows which ingredients run out most often. Marco: Any mobile use? Laura: Yes, the waste log has to work well on a phone. The admin reports can stay desktop-only."}
